zh: 相邻交换是可逆的：窗口交换一次能变成 key，等价于 key 交换一次能变成这个窗口。
所以先把 key 本身和 key 所有一次相邻交换后的结果放进一个集合，然后看 text 的每个等长窗口是否在集合中；用集合去重，同一个起点只算一次。
集合里放 key，以及对每个 i 交换 key 的第 i、i+1 个字符得到的字符串。枚举 text 中每个长度为 |key| 的窗口，在集合中就计数加一，最后输出计数。长度都不超过 50，直接截取子串即可。
en: An adjacent swap is reversible: a window can become key with one swap exactly when key can become that window with one swap.

So put key itself and every result of one adjacent swap of key into a set, then check whether each equal-length window of text is in the set; the set removes duplicates, so each start position counts once.

Fill the set with key and, for every i, the string obtained by swapping characters i and i+1 of key. Enumerate every window of text of length |key| and add one when it is in the set, then print the count. Lengths are at most 50, so plain substrings are fine.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Generate key itself and all distinct strings obtained from one adjacent swap, then enumerate the equal-length windows of text and look each one up in the set.

## Proof of correctness

An adjacent swap is reversible, so a window can become key with one swap exactly when it belongs to key's one-swap set. The set avoids counting the same start twice through duplicate swaps, and enumerating the windows covers every start.

## Complexity

Time O(|key|²+|text|·|key|), space O(|key|²).
